titulo_es: Evaluate a news of health or science

Resultatet tyder på samband.es: El resultado apunta a una posible relación
Resultatet tyder på samband.en: The result points to a possible relationship

texto: Explain uncertainty, data limits and impacts of a public measure. **Resultatet tyder på samband** means «The result points to a possible relationship». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 1 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
